instruction:
Please act as a professional Verilog designer. Your task is to create two Verilog modules that implement a Bluetooth transmitter and receiver blocks. 
The Bluetooth transmitter module should have the following inputs and outputs:

Inputs: a set of n input signals (data_in, clk, reset)
Outputs: a set of m output signals (tx_en, tx_out)
The module should also have the following parameters:

n: the width of the input data
m: the width of the output data
baud_rate: the data transmission rate in bits per second
Your module should implement the following functionality:

The module should take in the input data and the clock signal, and use them to transmit the data over Bluetooth.
The module should output a signal (tx_en) to enable the Bluetooth transmitter when data is being transmitted.
The data should be transmitted at the specified baud rate, with each bit being transmitted as a series of high and low voltage levels.
The output signal (tx_out) should be the transmitted data.
The Bluetooth receiver module should have the following inputs and outputs:

Inputs: a set of n input signals (rx_in, clk, reset)
Outputs: a set of m output signals (rx_en, data_out)
The module should also have the following parameters:

n: the width of the input data
m: the width of the output data
baud_rate: the data transmission rate in bits per second
Your module should implement the following functionality:

The module should take in the received data and the clock signal, and use them to receive the data over Bluetooth.
The module should output a signal (rx_en) to enable the Bluetooth receiver when data is being received.
The data should be received at the specified baud rate, with each bit being received as a series of high and low voltage levels.
The output signal (data_out) should be the received data.
To implement the transmitter and receiver modules, you should use Verilog code to define the data transmission and reception process as per the Bluetooth protocol. 
You should then use these functions to connect the inputs and outputs as per the given requirements.
